archetype: 5 (Jewel & Luxury - Light version) mixed with 1 (Organic & Earthy)
core_philosophy: Simple, uncluttered, professional, and sober. The design should evoke trust and heritage (tailoring/training) without being overly modern or extravagant. Focus on generous negative space and clear typography.

primary.name: Midnight Blue
primary.usage: Headings, primary CTA backgrounds, main navigation, borders

secondary.name: Pale Pink
secondary.usage: Subtle section backgrounds, hover states, accent elements

rules: Headings should use font-medium or font-semibold, avoid font-black for a sober look.
Body text should be highly legible with leading-relaxed.
Use uppercase with wide tracking for category labels and small subtitles.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Mobile-first. grid-cols-1 moving to grid-cols-2 or grid-cols-4 on desktop.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense text and product grids. Center-align hero text if appropriate for elegance.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0F172A] text-white hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors duration-200 px-6 py-3 rounded-none font-medium text-sm tracking-wide
buttons.whatsapp: bg-[#25D366] text-white hover:bg-[#128C7E] transition-colors duration-200 px-6 py-3 rounded-none font-medium flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: border border-[#0F172A] text-[#0F172A] hover:bg-[#FCE7F3] transition-colors duration-200 px-6 py-3 rounded-none font-medium text-sm tracking-wide

cards.style: No shadows. Use simple clean lines and high-quality imagery.

forms.inputs: w-full border-b border-[#E2E8F0] focus:border-[#0F172A] py-3 bg-transparent outline-none transition-colors rounded-none placeholder-slate-400

header.style: bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-50 border-b border-[#E2E8F0]

home.hero: Large elegant image, text overlay or side-by-side. If overlay, use a very light gradient or white box to ensure text readability. Include Slogan, Description, and WhatsApp CTA.
home.featured_products: A section displaying 3-4 top products in a clean grid.
home.about_snippet: A brief intro to the vocational center (Centre de Formation Professionnelle).

shop.layout: Sidebar or top bar for categories (Homme, Femme, Traditionnel, Mariage, Décontracté). Grid of product cards.
shop.product_card: Image, Name, Price. On hover, maybe a slight zoom on the image.

product_details.layout: Split layout. Left: Large image. Right: Product name, price, description, size/quantity selectors, prominent 'Commander via WhatsApp' button.

about.content: History of VAMOS, Mission statement, images of the seamstresses and center.
about.layout: Editorial layout. Alternating text and images. Asymmetrical grid.

contact.layout: Two columns. Left: Contact form (Name, Email, Message). Right: Contact details, Map or Image, WhatsApp direct link.

admin_dashboard.style: Functional, clean. Use Shadcn components (Table, Dialog, Form).

images.description: Elegant tailoring studio, hero image for the home page
Premium folded fabric texture for about page backgrounds or decorative sections
Woman cutting fabric, representing the vocational training center
Mannequins displaying clothing, suitable for shop category headers
Antique sewing machine, for the 'About' or 'Mission' section

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Minimal animations as requested. No bouncing or heavy transitions.
motion_and_interactions.interactions: Simple hover color transitions on buttons. Image slight zoom (scale 1.05) on product card hover.
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Fade in sections on scroll using simple opacity transitions.

icons_and_assets.usage: Use sparingly. Thin stroke width (1.5) to match the elegant typography.

testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Ensure Midnight Blue text on Pale Pink or White backgrounds meets WCAG AA standards.
testing_and_accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='whatsapp-order-button').
testing_and_accessibility.forms: All form inputs must have accessible labels.
